name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Fenwick goes with exactly one of Evocation, Necromancy, or Cat.
Conjuration goes with either Sable or Cat (but not both).
Between Evocation and Illusion, one goes with Kael and the other with Thorne.
Lyra, Evocation, and Owl belong to different adventurers.
If Raven goes with Fenwick, then Thorne goes with Abjuration.
Either Lyra goes with Illusion, or Thorne goes with Owl — but not both.
Either Lyra goes with Conjuration or Conjuration goes with Kael.
Abjuration goes with at least one of Fenwick, Owl, or Viper.
